remarks: Clean and cheerful house on a serene country cul-de-sac. Everything is done for your comfort and enjoyment. All large rooms with hardwood floors throughout. Flexible floor plan with primary bedrooms on either the first or second floor. Oversize 3-season sun room. Private deck. 2-story outbuilding as a potential art studio/home office/arts & crafts space/tradesman workshop/warehouse. All together 5000+ SF of usable space in two buildings. Close to local train station and historic Ridgefield Center. Award winning schools. Reference and credit check are required. No smokers. One pet ok, but must be discussed with Landlord.
